title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand, 49-Inch, Solid Brass, Soho Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels off the counter and within reach—without any wall mounting. This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand adds flexible towel storage with four rotating arms and a weighted base designed to help prevent tipping.

  • Separate and air towels easily with 4 pivoting swing arms that rotate for access and spacing.
  • No drilling required thanks to a freestanding, floor-standing design—ideal for bathrooms where you can’t or don’t want to mount hardware.
  • Stable, confident placement with a heavy solid brass base that is weighted to help prevent tipping.
  • Protect finished surfaces with a felt pad on the base.
  • Coordinate your space with the Soho collection for a matching Soho look alongside transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Specs & Details

  • Material: Brass (solid brass)
  • Overall dimensions: 12 in L x 49 in H x 9.25 in W
  • Diameter: 1 in

  • Mounting type: Freestanding (vertical stand)
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Includes: Towel stand
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

Keep towels off the counter and within reach—without any wall mounting in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand adds flexible towel storage with four rotating arms and a weighted base designed to help prevent tipping.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stable, confident placement with a heavy solid brass base that is weighted to help prevent tipping.
  • Protect finished surfaces with a felt pad on the base.
  • Coordinate your space with the Soho collection for a matching Soho look alongside transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Specs & Details

  • Material: Brass (solid brass)
  • Overall dimensions: 12 in L x 49 in H x 9.25 in W
  • Diameter: 1 in
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Mounting type: Freestanding (vertical stand)
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Includes: Towel stand
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
